title: Unit – 4 : Session – 10 : SLO – 2  |  Client-Server Communication Using the socket Module
sections: I. Steps to Create a Simple TCP Server
1. Create the socket: s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)  # IPv4 + TCP
2. Bind it to an address: s.bind(("localhost", 5000))
3. Start listening: s.listen(1)  # backlog of 1 pending connection
4. Accept a client: conn, addr = s.accept()  # blocks until a client connects
5. Exchange data: data = conn.recv(1024); conn.send(b"Hello client")
